title: Receiving a review without taking it personally

videos.script: Bruno opens his pull request in the morning, and by lunch it has four comments on it. One of them says his form accepts an empty pickup time. {{comments}} His first reaction is the one almost everybody has. A small drop in the stomach, and a sentence forming in his head that starts with: well, actually. {{reaction}} This lesson is about what happens next. {{next}} The comment is not about Bruno. It is about one line of a form, and it found a bug before a customer did, which is exactly what review is for. The sooner that feels true, the easier every review becomes. {{about}} You will learn to read a review before answering any of it, and to sort it by how serious each comment is. {{sort}} You will learn to answer every comment, even when the answer is: done. And to fix things with new commits, so the reviewer can see exactly what changed since they last looked. {{answer}} And you will learn to disagree. With a reason, once, in writing. And to know the moment when a conversation should stop being typed and start being spoken. {{title}}
